task: Design a numerical Engineer Monkey unit while retaining the supplied interpretation of sentries, support and traps. Unsupported actor behavior stays a proposal.

documents.text: Engineer Monkey is a Support tower. Medium placement costs 350. Its base attack fires piercing nails about every 0.7 seconds at range 40, dealing 1 damage with pierce 3. Sentry Gun periodically deploys temporary attacking sentries; Sentry Expert produces specialized types and Sentry Champion produces stronger unstable sentries that explode when their deployment ends. Cleansing Foam places foam that removes Camo and Regrow and can destroy Lead layers. Overclock is a targeted temporary attack-speed boost ability; Ultraboost adds a permanent stacking component. Pin briefly immobilizes ordinary targets; Double Gun adds a second nail gun. Bloon Trap captures ordinary targets for cash; XXXL Trap captures eligible MOAB-class targets.
Use the explicit numerical Definition supplied by the btd6 preset. Retain nail delivery and purchase gates. Sentries, foam and traps are proposed design groupings, not additional source facts.
